decisions.reason: The air quality module is a core environmental sensing product with steady demand from schools and building automation, so its results meet aspiration and give no reason to search for other uses of its resources.
As the current generation of a basic measurement module, it anchors the platform's analog sensing line and is cheap to carry.
The MQTT proxy may be superseded by native MQTT bindings, which creates some risk of replacement, but software carries almost no inventory cost, so slack lets the firm keep it for existing users.
The CAN bus interface serves industrial and automotive customers whose needs fit the firm's automation focus, and there is no sign of a shortfall.
Demand for CO2 monitoring rose after 2020, especially for classroom ventilation, so this module likely exceeds aspiration levels.
The touch panel is a niche accessory and component shortages could prompt catalogue pruning, but it costs little to carry and supports the display modules, so it stays for now.
